commits.subject: Session slice 1: open (package -> folio snapshot), revision-checked submit of chronicle-prepared transactions, atomic save, enumerable instance-owned provider registry, one Observe report per operation
Session slice 1: four real round-trip contract tests (open/edit/undo/save/reopen, revision refusals, cancellation+budgets+hostile input, provider isolation) and session-consumer example

capabilities_done: Session::open_path / open_bytes: bounded PackageReader stream -> folio Snapshot; assets held (HeldAssets) for re-save; unknown entries kept verbatim; read-only documents refused (read_only_document); per-property revision vector seeded at 0 for every editable layer/artboard/page-spread property

Session::submit(provider, params, expected_revision, cancel): provider proposes a chronicle Prepared on the immutable snapshot; session re-checks expected document revision (stale_revision), proposal document id, observed revision, successor == current+1, and that each revision update follows the session vector; publishes atomically or not at all; Applied carries revisions, updates and the chronicle inverse

Session::save / save_to: package write_package_with (quarantined entries verbatim, codec inherited from the opened package) -> save_atomic -> re-read of the destination manifest (revision + document id) -> VerifyMismatch otherwise; previews dropped and counted
ProviderRegistry (instance-owned, no global state): validated ids [a-z0-9._-]{1,64}, duplicate/full refusal, sorted ids()/list(), built-in chronicle.patch provider (params = chronicle Patch JSON)
Cancellation: accord CancellationToken at entry, inside provider/chronicle, and again before commit; budgets: package Limits + chronicle Budget (folio inside), validated at open

One Observe terminal frame per operation (open, submit, save), success or failure; fresh token for the report so a cancel after commit cannot recast a committed edit; opens that fail before the container names its document report Unaddressed (no frame)
examples/session-consumer.rs: --descriptor, --demo DIR, --open IN --rename ID NAME [--hide ID] --save OUT [--cancel]; independent read of the saved file via package::read_package

dep_requests: builders/dep-requests.jsonl: serde_json 1.0.151 (dev) for tests/example; all runtime deps are allowed path edges (accord, folio, chronicle, package, observe); no new crates.io runtime dependency. Cargo.lock/root Cargo.toml untouched by this lane.
decisions: Followed the lead dispatch SLICE 1 (open/apply/save/registry/cancel/observe) over the brief's port-heavy minimal slice; the brief's GrantPort/CommitPort/JobPort, idempotency keys + receipts, reconcile and shutdown drain are the next slice
No Session-per-agent: the session accepts transactions from any actor (attribution travels in the chronicle Patch actor), per FILM-ROOT-01 (one document owner)
Document-level expected revision is checked IN ADDITION to chronicle's property-level revision vector (the vector is the footprint check; STU-ARC-011)
Property revisions are session-local counters (start 0 at open); they are not persisted in the package
known_gaps: brief ports not in this slice: GrantPort / CommitPort / JobPort, idempotency keys + receipts, outcome-unknown reconcile, shutdown drain (next slice); public wire envelopes belong to kernel-bindings
assets are held in memory after open (package Opened); lazy PackageReader::read_asset streaming is a later slice
previews are dropped on save (derived data describing the pre-edit document) and counted in SaveReceipt.previews_dropped
post-save verification failure (VerifyMismatch) leaves the newly written file in place and does not advance saved_revision
resolver in session-consumer grants everything: example stand-in only
next: Validator round on a7640e7. Next slice: injected GrantPort/CommitPort ports with idempotency keys + canonical receipts, reconcile after unknown commit outcome, admission budget (capacity/overload), shutdown drain on a test clock; then export_checkpoint via package.
